name: Swept path (vehicles, aircraft, light rail)
description: Drive a vehicle, an aircraft or a light rail car along a path in CivilCraft and see the ground it sweeps and what it touches. Pick a vehicle from a pack or make your own, check the run against kerbs, buildings and lines, send conflicts to Problems, draw a roundabout, lay out a parking lot. A planning aid: an engineer decides.
author: CadCraft
